arguments.sql:
WITH pizza_orders AS (
    SELECT o.rowid AS row_id,
           o.order_id,
           o.customer_id,
           o.order_time,
           o.pizza_id,
           n.pizza_name,
           o.exclusions,
           o.extras
    FROM main.pizza_clean_customer_orders AS o
    JOIN main.pizza_names AS n ON n.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
),
recipe_toppings AS (
    SELECT r.pizza_id, topping.value AS topping_id
    FROM main.pizza_recipes AS r
    CROSS JOIN json_each('[' || r.toppings || ']') AS topping
),
ingredient_occurrences AS (
    SELECT o.row_id, r.topping_id
    FROM pizza_orders AS o
    JOIN recipe_toppings AS r ON r.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM json_each('[' || COALESCE(o.exclusions, '') || ']') AS excluded
        WHERE excluded.value = r.topping_id
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT o.row_id, extra.value AS topping_id
    FROM pizza_orders AS o
    CROSS JOIN json_each('[' || COALESCE(o.extras, '') || ']') AS extra
),
ingredient_counts AS (
    SELECT row_id, topping_id, COUNT(*) AS quantity
    FROM ingredient_occurrences
    GROUP BY row_id, topping_id
)
SELECT o.row_id,
       o.order_id,
       o.customer_id,
       o.pizza_name,
       o.pizza_name || ': ' || COALESCE(
           GROUP_CONCAT(
               CASE WHEN i.quantity > 1 THEN '2x' ELSE '' END || t.topping_name,
               ', ' ORDER BY (i.quantity > 1) DESC, t.topping_name COLLATE NOCASE
           ),
           ''
       ) AS ingredients,
       CASE WHEN o.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS pizza_id
FROM pizza_orders AS o
LEFT JOIN ingredient_counts AS i ON i.row_id = o.row_id
LEFT JOIN main.pizza_toppings AS t ON t.topping_id = i.topping_id
GROUP BY o.row_id, o.order_id, o.pizza_name, o.order_time
ORDER BY o.row_id ASC
LIMIT -1
